items.title: Frank Foster — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: He took me under his wing... He was like a mentor to me, Paul Robinson.

ctx.x: I’m talking about the musicians that you were meeting in these situations, with Jack, with others, that you went to school with on the horn and what that was about.

There was a guy named Paul Robinson who played clarinet. He almost sounded like -- if you closed your eyes you would have thought you were listening to Benny Goodman. This is a black guy, and he’s a light-skin black.
